title: Faxina com música
grammar: While + passado contínuo para duas ações ao mesmo tempo
goal: Use while + was/were + -ing para dizer que duas ações aconteciam ao mesmo tempo.
reading: While Noah was taking out the garbage, Ava was cleaning the kitchen.
Enquanto Noah tirava o lixo, Ava limpava a cozinha.
Their mother was cooking dinner while the music was playing.
A mãe deles preparava o jantar enquanto a música tocava.
The maid was cleaning the pipes in the hall.
A faxineira limpava os canos no corredor.
While everyone was working, Lou was singing loudly.
Enquanto todos trabalhavam, Lou cantava bem alto.
The house was clean when their father came home.
A casa estava limpa quando o pai chegou.
dialogue: What were you doing while I was shopping?
O que você estava fazendo enquanto eu fazia compras?
I was cleaning the kitchen with Ava.
Eu estava limpando a cozinha com a Ava.
Yes, he was taking out the garbage.
Nico was. He was dancing with a mop!
Era o Nico. Ele dançava com um esfregão!
She was cleaning the vacuum tube and its wheels.
Ela limpava o tubo do aspirador e as rodas dele.
pron: Em while, o w é arredondado e o final é um l escuro, com a língua no céu da boca.
While I was cooking, he sang.
gram: Ava was cleaning ___ Noah was cooking.
While liga duas ações seguidas de verbo; during vem com substantivo.
